paragraphs.sourceText: Millions of Americans and foreigners see G.I. Joe as a mindless war toy, the symbol of American military adventurism, but that’s not how it used to be. To the men and women who 1 in World War Ⅱ and the people they liberated, the G.I. was the 2 man grown into hero, the poor farm kid torn away from his home, the guy who 3 all the burdens of battle, who slept in cold foxholes, who went without the 4 of food and shelter, who stuck it out and drove back the Nazi reign of murder. This was not a volunteer soldier, not someone well paid, 5 an average guy, up 6 the best trained, best equipped, fiercest, most brutal enemies seen in centuries.
paragraphs.translationZh: 数以百万计的美国人和外国人观看《G.I.》乔作为一个无意识的战争玩具，是美国军事冒险主义的象征，但现在已经不是这样了。对于在第二次世界大战中服役的男女军人以及他们解放的人民，G.I.是一个成长为英雄的普通人，一个被赶出家门的可怜的农场孩子，一个承担了所有战斗负担的人，一个睡在寒冷的散兵坑里的人，一个没有食物和住所的必需品的人，一个坚持到底并击退了纳粹谋杀统治的人。这不是一名志愿士兵，也不是一个高薪的人，而是一个普通人，面对的是几个世纪以来训练最好、装备最好、最凶猛、最残酷的敌人。

paragraphs.sourceText: His name isn’t much. G.I. is just a military abbreviation 7 Government Issue, and it was on all of the articles 8 to soldiers. And Joe? A common name for a guy who never 9 it to the top. Joe Blow, Joe Palooka, Joe Magrac… a working class name. The United States has 10 had a president or vice-president or secretary of state Joe.

paragraphs.translationZh: 在 1945 年的电影《特种部队的故事》中，他作为一个角色或一群美国人物出现。乔，根据战地记者厄尼·派尔的最后日子改编。派尔采访的一些士兵在影片中描绘了自己。派尔以报道战争中人性的一面而闻名，他写的是那些泥泞的士兵，而不是前进了多少英里，或者占领或解放了哪些城镇。他的报告与著名星条旗艺术家比尔·莫尔登的《威利》漫画相似。两人都强调了战争的肮脏和疲惫，以及士兵们和平民之间分享的文明碎片：咖啡、烟草、威士忌、住所、睡眠。对于埃及、法国和其他十几个国家，G.I.乔是任何一名美国士兵，当时是他们生命中最重要的人。

paragraphs.sourceText: Read the following four texts. Answer the questions after each text by choosing A, B, C or D. Mark your answers on the ANSWER SHEET. (40 points)
paragraphs.translationZh: 阅读下面四篇课文。选择 A、B、C 或 D 来回答每篇课文后的问题。在答题卡上标记您的答案。 （40分）

paragraphs.sourceText: Homework has never been terribly popular with students and even many parents, but in recent years it has been particularly scorned. School districts across the country, most recently Los Angeles Unified, are revising their thinking on this educational ritual. Unfortunately, L.A. Unified has produced an inflexible policy which mandates that with the exception of some advanced courses, homework may no longer count for more than 10% of a student’s academic grade.
paragraphs.translationZh: 家庭作业从来都不太受学生甚至许多家长的欢迎，但近年来它尤其受到蔑视。全国各地的学区，最近的洛杉矶联合学区，正在修改他们对这种教育仪式的想法。不幸的是，洛杉矶联合大学制定了一项不灵活的政策，规定除某些高级课程外，家庭作业在学生学业成绩中所占的比例可能不再超过 10%。

paragraphs.sourceText: This rule is meant to address the difficulty that students from impoverished or chaotic homes might have in completing their homework. But the policy is unclear and contradictory. Certainly, no homework should be assigned that students cannot complete on their own or that they cannot do without expensive equipment. But if the district is essentially giving a pass to students who do not do their homework because of complicated family lives, it is going riskily close to the implication that standards need to be lowered for poor children.
paragraphs.translationZh: 这条规则的目的是解决来自贫困或混乱家庭的学生完成作业的困难。但政策不明确且矛盾。当然，不应该布置学生无法独立完成或没有昂贵设备就无法完成的作业。但如果该学区本质上是给那些因为家庭生活复杂而不做作业的学生发放通行证，那么这就很危险地接近于需要降低贫困儿童的标准了。

paragraphs.sourceText: District administrators say that homework will still be a part of schooling; teachers are allowed to assign as much of it as they want. But with homework counting for no more than 10% of their grades, students can easily skip half their homework and see very little difference on their report cards. Some students might do well on state tests without completing their homework, but what about the students who performed well on the tests and did their homework? It is quite possible that the homework helped. Yet rather than empowering teachers to find what works best for their students, the policy imposes a flat, across-the-board rule.
paragraphs.translationZh: 学区管理人员表示，家庭作业仍将是学校教育的一部分；教师可以根据需要分配任意数量的内容。但由于家庭作业占成绩的比例不超过 10%，学生可以轻松跳过一半的家庭作业，并且在成绩单上看不到什么差别。有些学生可能在没有完成作业的情况下在州考试中取得好成绩，但是那些在考试中表现良好并完成作业的学生呢？家庭作业很可能有帮助。然而，该政策并没有让教师找到最适合学生的方法，而是强加了一条统一的、全面的规则。

paragraphs.sourceText: At the same time, the policy addresses none of the truly thorny questions about homework. If the district finds homework to be unimportant to its students’ academic achievement, it should move to reduce or eliminate the assignments, not make them count for almost nothing. Conversely, if homework matters, it should account for a significant portion of the grade. Meanwhile, this policy does nothing to ensure that the homework students receive is meaningful or appropriate to their age and the subject, or that teachers are not assigning more than they’re willing to review and correct.
paragraphs.translationZh: 与此同时，该政策没有解决有关家庭作业的任何真正棘手的问题。如果学区发现家庭作业对学生的学业成绩并不重要，就应该减少或取消作业，而不是让它们几乎毫无价值。相反，如果家庭作业很重要，它应该占成绩的很大一部分。与此同时，这项政策并不能确保学生收到的家庭作业有意义或适合他们的年龄和科目，或者教师布置的作业不会超出他们愿意复习和纠正的范围。

paragraphs.sourceText: The homework rules should be put on hold while the school board, which is responsible for setting educational policy, looks into the matter and conducts public hearings. It is not too late for L.A. Unified to do homework right.
paragraphs.translationZh: 在负责制定教育政策的学校董事会调查此事并举行公开听证会期间，家庭作业规则应暂停。对于洛杉矶联合大学来说，做好功课还不算太晚。

paragraphs.sourceText: Pretty in pink: adult women do not remember being so obsessed with the colour, yet it is pervasive in our young girls’ lives. It is not that pink is intrinsically bad, but it is such a tiny slice of the rainbow and, though it may celebrate girlhood in one way, it also repeatedly and firmly fuses girls’ identity to appearance. Then it presents that connection, even among two-year-olds, between girls as not only innocent but as evidence of innocence. Looking around, I despaired at the singular lack of imagination about girls’ lives and interests.
paragraphs.translationZh: 漂亮的粉色：成年女性不记得自己对这种颜色如此着迷，但它在我们年轻女孩的生活中无处不在。并不是说粉色本质上不好，而是它只是彩虹中的一小部分，尽管它可能以某种方式庆祝少女时代，但它也反复而坚定地将女孩的身份与外表融合在一起。然后，它展示了女孩之间的这种联系，即使是在两岁的孩子之间，不仅是无辜的，而且是无辜的证据。环顾四周，我对女孩的生活和兴趣缺乏想象力感到绝望。

paragraphs.sourceText: Girls’ attraction to pink may seem unavoidable, somehow encoded in their DNA, but according to Jo Paoletti, an associate professor of American Studies, it is not. Children were not colour-coded at all until the early 20th century: in the era before domestic washing machines all babies wore white as a practical matter, since the only way of getting clothes clean was to boil them. What’s more, both boys and girls wore what were thought of as gender-neutral dresses. When nursery colours were introduced, pink was actually considered the more masculine colour, a pastel version of red, which was associated with strength. Blue, with its intimations of the Virgin Mary, constancy and faithfulness, symbolised femininity. It was not until the mid-1980s, when amplifying age and sex differences became a dominant children’s marketing strategy, that pink fully came into its own, when it began to seem inherently attractive to girls, part of what defined them as female, at least for the first few critical years.
paragraphs.translationZh: 女孩对粉色的吸引力似乎是不可避免的，不知何故编码在她们的 DNA 中，但根据美国研究副教授乔·保莱蒂 (Jo Paoletti) 的说法，事实并非如此。直到20世纪初，孩子们才被用颜色区分：在家用洗衣机还没有出现的时代，所有婴儿实际上都穿白色的衣服，因为清洗衣服的唯一方法就是将它们煮沸。更重要的是，男孩和女孩都穿着被认为是中性的衣服。当引入童趣色时，粉色实际上被认为是更男性化的颜色，是红色的柔和版本，与力量相关。蓝色暗示着圣母玛利亚、坚贞和忠诚，象征着女性气质。直到 20 世纪 80 年代中期，扩大年龄和性别差异成为儿童营销的主要策略时，粉色才完全发挥了作用，它开始对女孩具有天生的吸引力，这也是她们被定义为女性的一部分，至少在最初的关键几年是这样。

paragraphs.sourceText: I had not realized how profoundly marketing trends dictated our perception of what is natural to kids, including our core beliefs about their psychological development. Take the toddler. I assumed that phase was something experts developed after years of research into children’s behaviour: wrong. Turns out, according to Daniel Cook, a historian of childhood consumerism, it was popularised as a marketing trick by clothing manufacturers in the 1930s.
paragraphs.translationZh: 我没有意识到营销趋势如何深刻地决定了我们对孩子自然行为的看法，包括我们对他们心理发展的核心信念。带着小孩。我以为这个阶段是专家们对儿童行为进行多年研究后得出的结论：错误的。儿童消费主义历史学家丹尼尔·库克 (Daniel Cook) 表示，事实证明，这种做法在 20 世纪 30 年代被服装制造商作为一种营销技巧而普及。

paragraphs.sourceText: Trade publications counselled department stores that, in order to increase sales, they should create a “third stepping stone” between infant wear and older kids’ clothes. It was only after “toddler” became a common shoppers’ term that it evolved into a broadly accepted developmental stage. Splitting kids, or adults, into ever-tinier categories has proved a sure-fire way to boost profits. And one of the easiest ways to segment a market is to magnify gender differences — or invent them where they did not previously exist.
paragraphs.translationZh: 贸易出版物建议百货公司，为了增加销售额，他们应该在婴儿服装和大童服装之间建立“第三块垫脚石”。直到“幼儿”成为一个常见的购物术语之后，它才演变成一个被广泛接受的发展阶段。事实证明，将儿童或成人分成更小的类别是增加利润的可靠方法。细分市场最简单的方法之一就是放大性别差异，或者在以前不存在的地方创造性别差异。

paragraphs.sourceText: In 2010, a federal judge shook America’s biotech industry to its core. Companies had won patents for isolated DNA for decades — by 2005 some 20% of human genes were patented. But in March 2010 a judge ruled that genes were unpatentable. Executives were violently agitated. The Biotechnology Industry Organization (BIO), a trade group, assured members that this was just a “preliminary step” in a longer battle.
paragraphs.translationZh: 2010 年，一位联邦法官彻底震撼了美国生物技术产业。数十年来，各家公司都获得了分离 DNA 的专利——到 2005 年，大约 20% 的人类基因获得了专利。但 2010 年 3 月，一位法官裁定基因不可申请专利。高管们非常激动。贸易组织生物技术工业组织（BIO）向成员保证，这只是一场长期斗争中的“初步步骤”。

paragraphs.sourceText: On July 29th they were relieved, at least temporarily. A federal appeals court overturned the prior decision, ruling that Myriad Genetics could indeed hold patents to two genes that help forecast a woman’s risk of breast cancer. The chief executive of Myriad, a company in Utah, said the ruling was a blessing to firms and patients alike.
paragraphs.translationZh: 7 月 29 日，他们松了一口气，至少暂时松了口气。联邦上诉法院推翻了先前的裁决，裁定 Myriad Genetics 确实可以拥有两个有助于预测女性患乳腺癌风险的基因的专利。犹他州 Myriad 公司的首席执行官表示，这一裁决对公司和患者来说都是一件好事。

paragraphs.sourceText: But as companies continue their attempts at personalized medicine, the courts will remain rather busy. The Myriad case itself is probably not over. Critics make three main arguments against gene patents: a gene is a product of nature, so it may not be patented; gene patents suppress innovation rather than reward it; and patents’ monopolies restrict access to genetic tests such as Myriad’s. A growing number seem to agree. Last year a federal task-force urged reform for patents related to genetic tests. In October the Department of Justice filed a brief in the Myriad case, arguing that an isolated DNA molecule “is no less a product of nature...than are cotton fibres that have been separated from cotton seeds.”
paragraphs.translationZh: 但随着公司继续尝试个性化医疗，法院将仍然相当忙碌。 Myriad 案本身可能还没有结束。批评者对基因专利提出了三个主要论点：基因是自然的产物，因此不能申请专利；基因专利抑制创新而不是奖励创新；专利垄断限制了 Myriad 等基因检测的使用。越来越多的人似乎同意这一观点。去年，一个联邦工作组敦促对与基因测试相关的专利进行改革。 10 月，司法部就 Myriad 案提交了一份简报，认为分离出的 DNA 分子“与从棉籽中分离出来的棉花纤维一样，都是自然产物……”。

paragraphs.sourceText: Despite the appeals court’s decision, big questions remain unanswered. For example, it is unclear whether the sequencing of a whole genome violates the patents of individual genes within it. The case may yet reach the Supreme Court.
paragraphs.translationZh: 尽管上诉法院做出了裁决，但仍有一些重大问题没有得到解答。例如，目前尚不清楚整个基因组的测序是否侵犯了其中单个基因的专利。该案可能仍会提交最高法院。

paragraphs.sourceText: As the industry advances, however, other suits may have an even greater impact. Companies are unlikely to file many more patents for human DNA molecules — most are already patented or in the public domain. Firms are now studying how genes interact, looking for correlations that might be used to determine the causes of disease or predict a drug’s efficacy. Companies are eager to win patents for “connecting the dots,” explains Hans Sauer, a lawyer for the BIO.
paragraphs.translationZh: 然而，随着行业的进步，其他诉讼可能会产生更大的影响。公司不太可能为人类 DNA 分子申请更多专利——大多数已经获得专利或属于公共领域。公司现在正在研究基因如何相互作用，寻找可用于确定疾病原因或预测药物疗效的相关性。 BIO 律师汉斯·索尔 (Hans Sauer) 解释说，公司渴望赢得“连接点”的专利。

paragraphs.sourceText: Their success may be determined by a suit related to this issue, brought by the Mayo Clinic, which the Supreme Court will hear in its next term. The BIO recently held a convention which included sessions to coach lawyers on the shifting landscape for patents. Each meeting was packed.
paragraphs.translationZh: 他们的成功可能取决于梅奥诊所提起的与此问题相关的诉讼，最高法院将在下个任期审理该诉讼。 BIO 最近举行了一次会议，其中包括对律师进行关于专利格局变化的培训课程。每次会议都座无虚席。

paragraphs.sourceText: The great recession may be over, but this era of high joblessness is probably beginning. Before it ends, it will likely change the life course and character of a generation of young adults. And ultimately, it is likely to reshape our politics, our culture, and the character of our society for years.
paragraphs.translationZh: 大衰退可能已经结束，但这个高失业率的时代可能正在开始。在它结束之前，它很可能会改变一代年轻人的生命历程和性格。最终，它可能会在未来几年重塑我们的政治、文化和社会特征。

paragraphs.sourceText: No one tries harder than the jobless to find silver linings in this national economic disaster. Many said that unemployment, while extremely painful, had improved them in some ways: they had become less materialistic and more financially prudent; they were more aware of the struggles of others. In limited respects, perhaps the recession will leave society better off. At the very least, it has awoken us from our national fever dream of easy riches and bigger houses, and put a necessary end to an era of reckless personal spending.
paragraphs.translationZh: 没有人比失业者更努力地在这场国家经济灾难中寻找一线希望。许多人表示，失业虽然极其痛苦，但在某些方面改善了他们：他们变得不那么物质主义，在财务上更加谨慎；他们更了解其他人的挣扎。在有限的方面，经济衰退也许会让社会变得更好。至少，它唤醒了我们对轻松致富和拥有更大房子的全民狂热梦想，并结束了不计后果的个人消费时代。

paragraphs.sourceText: But for the most part, these benefits seem thin, uncertain, and far off. In The Moral Consequences of Economic Growth, the economic historian Benjamin Friedman argues that both inside and outside the U.S., lengthy periods of economic stagnation or decline have almost always left society more mean-spirited and less inclusive, and have usually stopped or reversed the advance of rights and freedoms. Anti-immigrant sentiment typically increases, as does conflict between races and classes.
paragraphs.translationZh: 但在大多数情况下，这些好处似乎微不足道、不确定且遥远。经济历史学家本杰明·弗里德曼在《经济增长的道德后果》一书中指出，无论是在美国国内还是国外，长期的经济停滞或衰退几乎总是会让社会更加卑鄙、包容性更差，并且通常会阻止或逆转权利和自由的进步。反移民情绪通常会增加，种族和阶级之间的冲突也会增加。

paragraphs.sourceText: Income inequality usually falls during a recession, but it has not shrunk in this one. Indeed, this period of economic weakness may reinforce class divides, and decrease opportunities to cross them — especially for young people. The research of Till Von Wachter, the economist at Columbia University, suggests that not all people graduating into a recession see their life chances dimmed: those with degrees from elite universities catch up fairly quickly to where they otherwise would have been if they had graduated in better times; it is the masses beneath them that are left behind.
paragraphs.translationZh: 收入不平等通常会在经济衰退期间缩小，但在这次衰退中并没有缩小。事实上，这段经济疲软时期可能会加剧阶级鸿沟，并减少跨越鸿沟的机会——尤其是对年轻人而言。哥伦比亚大学经济学家蒂尔·冯·瓦赫特 (Till Von Wachter) 的研究表明，并非所有在经济衰退中毕业的人都会看到自己的生活机会变得黯淡：那些拥有精英大学学位的人很快就会赶上如果他们在更好的时期毕业的话本可以达到的水平；被抛在后面的是他们下面的群众。

paragraphs.sourceText: In the Internet age, it is particularly easy to see the resentment that has always been hidden within American society. More difficult, in the moment, is discerning precisely how these lean times are affecting society’s character. In many respects, the U.S. was more socially tolerant entering this recession than at any time in its history, and a variety of national polls on social conflict since then have shown mixed results. We will have to wait and see exactly how these hard times will reshape our social fabric. But they certainly will reshape it, and all the more so the longer they extend.
paragraphs.translationZh: 在网络时代，特别容易看到美国社会内部一直隐藏的怨恨情绪。目前，更困难的是准确辨别这些经济不景气的时期如何影响社会特征。从许多方面来看，美国在进入这场衰退时比历史上任何时候都更加宽容，而且自那时以来有关社会冲突的各种全国性民意调查显示出不同的结果。我们将不得不拭目以待，看看这些困难时期将如何重塑我们的社会结构。但他们肯定会重塑它，而且随着时间的延长，情况更是如此。

paragraphs.sourceText: Read the following text and answer the questions by finding information from the left column that corresponds to each of the marked details given in the right column. There are two extra choices in the right column. Mark your answer on the ANSWER SHEET. (10 points)
paragraphs.translationZh: 阅读以下文本，并通过从左栏中查找与右栏中给出的每个标记详细信息相对应的信息来回答问题。右栏中有两个额外的选项。在答题卡上标记您的答案。 （10分）

paragraphs.sourceText: “Universal history, the history of what man has accomplished in this world, is at bottom the History of the Great Men who have worked here,” wrote the Victorian sage Thomas Carlyle. Well, not any more it is not.
paragraphs.translationZh: 维多利亚时代的圣人托马斯·卡莱尔写道：“普遍的历史，即人类在这个世界上所取得的成就的历史，归根结底是在这里工作过的伟人的历史。”好吧，不再是这样了。

paragraphs.sourceText: Suddenly, Britain looks to have fallen out with its favorite historical form. This could be no more than a passing literary craze, but it also points to a broader truth about how we now approach the past: less concerned with learning from forefathers and more interested in feeling their pain. Today, we want empathy, not inspiration.
paragraphs.translationZh: 突然之间，英国似乎与它最喜欢的历史形式发生了争执。这可能只不过是一种短暂的文学热潮，但它也指出了一个关于我们现在如何对待过去的更广泛的事实：不太关心向祖先学习，而更感兴趣的是感受他们的痛苦。今天，我们需要的是同理心，而不是灵感。

paragraphs.sourceText: From the earliest days of the Renaissance, the writing of history meant recounting the exemplary lives of great men. In 1337, Petrarch began work on his rambling writing De Viris Illustribus — On Famous Men, highlighting the virtus (or virtue) of classical heroes. Petrarch celebrated their greatness in conquering fortune and rising to the top. This was the biographical tradition which Niccolò Machiavelli turned on its head. In The Prince, he championed cunning, ruthlessness, and boldness, rather than virtue, mercy and justice, as the skills of successful leaders.
paragraphs.translationZh: 从文艺复兴初期开始，历史的书写就意味着讲述伟人的模范一生。 1337 年，彼特拉克开始撰写散漫的著作《De Viris Illustribus — On Famous Men》，强调古典英雄的美德（或美德）。彼特拉克庆祝他们征服财富并登上顶峰的伟大。这是尼科洛·马基雅维利颠覆的传记传统。在《王子》中，他提倡狡猾、无情和大胆，而不是美德、仁慈和正义，作为成功领导者的技能。

paragraphs.sourceText: Over time, the attributes of greatness shifted. The Romantics commemorated the leading painters and authors of their day, stressing the uniqueness of the artist’s personal experience rather than public glory. By contrast, the Victorian author Samuel Smiles wrote Self-Help as a catalogue of the worthy lives of engineers, industrialists and explorers. “The valuable examples which they furnish of the power of self-help, of patient purpose, resolute working, and steadfast integrity, issuing in the formation of truly noble and manly character, exhibit,” wrote Smiles, “what it is in the power of each to accomplish for himself.” His biographies of James Watt, Richard Arkwright and Josiah Wedgwood were held up as beacons to guide the working man through his difficult life.
paragraphs.translationZh: 随着时间的推移，伟大的属性发生了变化。浪漫主义者纪念他们那个时代的主要画家和作家，强调艺术家个人经历的独特性，而不是公众的荣耀。相比之下，维多利亚时代的作家塞缪尔·斯迈尔斯（Samuel Smiles）将《自助》写成了工程师、实业家和探险家的有价值生活的目录。斯迈尔斯写道：“他们提供的有价值的例子体现了自助的力量、耐心的目标、坚决的工作和坚定的正直，从而形成了真正高贵和男子气概的品格，展示了每个人有能力为自己实现什么。”他为詹姆斯·瓦特、理查德·阿克莱特和乔赛亚·韦奇伍德撰写的传记被视为指引工人度过艰难生活的灯塔。

paragraphs.sourceText: This was all a bit bourgeois for Thomas Carlyle, who focused his biographies on the truly heroic lives of Martin Luther, Oliver Cromwell and Napoleon Bonaparte. These epochal figures represented lives hard to imitate, but to be acknowledged as possessing higher authority than mere mortals.
paragraphs.translationZh: 对于托马斯·卡莱尔来说，这有点资产阶级风格，他的传记重点关注马丁·路德、奥利弗·克伦威尔和拿破仑·波拿巴的真正英雄生活。这些划时代的人物所代表的生活难以模仿，但却被认为拥有比凡人更高的权威。

paragraphs.sourceText: Not everyone was convinced by such bombast. “The history of all hitherto existing society is the history of class struggles,” wrote Marx and Engels in The Communist Manifesto. For them, history did nothing, it possessed no immense wealth nor waged battles: “It is man, real, living man who does all that.” And history should be the story of the masses and their record of struggle. As such, it needed to appreciate the economic realities, the social contexts and power relations in which each epoch stood. For: “Men make their own history, but they do not make it just as they please; they do not make it under circumstances chosen by themselves, but under circumstances directly found, given and transmitted from the past.”
paragraphs.translationZh: 并非所有人都相信这种夸大其词的说法。马克思和恩格斯在《共产党宣言》中写道：“迄今为止一切社会的历史都是阶级斗争的历史。”对他们来说，历史什么也没做，它没有巨大的财富，也没有发动战争：“是人，真正的、活生生的人做了这一切。”历史应该是群众的故事和斗争的记录。因此，它需要了解每个时代的经济现实、社会背景和权力关系。因为：“人们创造了自己的历史，但他们并不是随心所欲地创造它；他们不是在自己选择的环境下创造的，而是在从过去直接发现、给予和传承的环境下创造的。”

paragraphs.sourceText: This was the tradition which revolutionized our appreciation of the past. In place of Thomas Carlyle, Britain nurtured Christopher Hill, EP Thompson and Eric Hobsbawm. History from below stood alongside biographies of great men. Whole new realms of understanding — from gender to race to cultural studies — were opened up as scholars unpicked the multiplicity of lost societies. And it transformed public history too: downstairs became just as fascinating as upstairs.
paragraphs.translationZh: 这一传统彻底改变了我们对过去的认识。英国取代了托马斯·卡莱尔，培养了克里斯托弗·希尔、EP·汤普森和埃里克·霍布斯鲍姆。自下而上的历史与伟人的传记并存。随着学者们揭开失落社会的多样性，全新的理解领域——从性别到种族再到文化研究——被开辟出来。它也改变了公共历史：楼下变得和楼上一样迷人。

paragraphs.sourceText: When people in developing countries worry about migration, they are usually concerned at the prospect of their best and brightest departure to Silicon Valley or to hospitals and universities in the developed world.
